code_summary: Custom checkpoint-selection protocol beyond the menu: train the same DeepFM+DIN pointwise model once for a fixed number of epochs using train_lib.run to materialize official per-row predictions, while separately using train_lib.selection_rule_test() on saved per-epoch validation predictions from a custom torch training loop to choose the epoch by user-split cross-validation rather than same-data validation argmax. No existing menu axis can express a different checkpoint-selection rule; n_checkpoints/checkpoint_combine only alter averaging, not how the winning epoch is selected. The script falls back to the standard best-valid epoch if the helper is unavailable, but still writes official outputs from the selected epoch only.
